class.name: CgameGOAPPlanner
class.brief_description: Deterministic Goal-Oriented Action Planning (A* over world states).
class.description: Native port of the Cgame GDScript GOAP planner, as popularised by F.E.A.R. Each action is a [Dictionary] [code]{"name": String, "cost": float, "preconditions": {key: value}, "effects": {key: value}}[/code]. The search is an A* over world states; the heuristic is the number of unsatisfied goal keys scaled by the cheapest action cost. Ties resolve by insertion order, so the same input always yields the same plan. [codeblock] var actions = [ {"name": "craft", "cost": 1.0, "preconditions": {}, "effects": {"weapon": true}}, {"name": "hunt", "cost": 2.0, "preconditions": {"weapon": true}, "effects": {"food": true}}, ] var plan = CgameGOAPPlanner.plan(actions, {}, {"food": true}) # ["craft", "hunt"] [/codeblock]

method.name: plan
method.description: Returns the action names of the cheapest plan that reaches [param goal] from [param state]. The result is empty when the goal is already satisfied, unreachable, or when [param max_nodes] expansions are exhausted.
